MINI MINUTES: No appearance. Order to Show Cause to Plaintiff in Propria Persona for failure to Complete Arbitration is heard this day. Therefore, it is hereby ordered that this matter be dismissed. The court finds that a less severe sanction would not be effective due to the history of lack of compliance. Notice Of Motion And Motion To Compel (1) Responses To Written Discovery Requests And (2) Attendance By Pltf At Deposition & Motion For Monetary Sanctions
Off Calendar Dec-10-2007 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: NO APPEARANCES. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. Defendant City And County Of San Francisco's Motion To Compel Responses To Written Discovery Requests and Attendance By Plaintiff At Deposition is granted. No opposition has been filed. Plaintiff's failure to respond and to appear for his deposition were a misuse of the discovery process. Plaintiff is ordered to respond to written discovery within 15 days of notice of this order. Plaintiff is further ordered to appear for his deposition at a time and place to be noticed by Defendant and to be completed no later than January 15, 2008. Sanctions are awarded against Plaintiff in the amount of $500, to be paid within 30 days of notice of this order. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
